title: Cottage By The Sea Vacation Rental
meta_description: Cottage By The Sea is a 3.00 bedroom, 2.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: DescriptionCottage By The SeaSeagrove Beach, FL | Crystal Court, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459Home Highlights3 Bedrooms | 2.5 BathroomsSleeps 10 Guests2,000+ Sq. Ft.1-Minute Walk to Deeded Beach Access & Community PoolCommunity Pool with Bathrooms4 Free Adult Bikes Included (Bikes not available Dec–Feb; additional rentals available)Pet-Friendly Home (1 pet max, 20 lbs or under; $250 non-refundable pet fee per pet. Must be listed and approved at booking)Turkish Towels ProvidedBeach Chairs, Toys & Rafts ProvidedFire Pit AvailableFlat-Screen TVs in All Bedrooms + Upstairs PorchDriveway Parking for 2 Vehicles (No street or yard parking)Laundry Room with Full-Size Washer & DryerWelcome to Cottage By The SeaNestled in the heart of Seagrove Beach, Cottage By The Sea is a beautifully updated coastal retreat designed for relaxation and charm. Perfect for families or groups of up to 10, this inviting home is just steps from the soft, white sands of the Gulf.The open-concept living area is bright and comfortable, with a stylish kitchen featuring granite countertops, stainless-steel appliances, and plenty of space for cooking together.First Floor:King bedroom with private bath accessJack-and-Jill bathroom with shared walk-in shower and dual vanitiesBunk room with two twin bunk sets (4 beds total) and flat-screen TVUpstairs Primary Suite:King bed with sleeper sofaSpacious en suite bath with garden tub and stand-alone showerPrivate wraparound balcony — perfect for morning coffee or sunset viewsOutdoor Spaces:Unwind in cozy seating areas, gather around the fire pit, or enjoy the nearby community pool and beach. The home includes 10 beach chairs and fun beach toys to make seaside days even better.Location & Nearby AttractionsSeagrove Beach blends laid-back luxury with natural beauty. Explore local boutiques, cafes, and restaurants, or visit Deer Lake State Park and the rare coastal dune lakes. Seaside is just 2 miles away, easily reached by golf cart, bike, or car, offering shopping, dining, and entertainment.Parking & Golf Cart PolicyDriveway parking for up to 2 vehicles (no street or yard parking permitted)Golf carts available for rent through South Walton Carts at a discounted rateAll vehicles and carts must fit in the designated parking areaBooking & PoliciesNo SmokingPublished rates do not include taxes and fees50% due at booking; balance due 60 days before arrival5% cancellation fee appliesFull refund (minus 5%) for cancellations made >60 days priorOptional travel insurance availableCheck-In: 4:00 PM CST | Check-Out: 10:00 AM CSTPet Policy: 1 pet max (20 lbs or under), $250 non-refundable feeSecurity camera on exterior onlyPrimary renter must be 25+ and stay on site Book your stay at Cottage By The Sea today and enjoy the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and coastal charm in Seagrove Beach!
